## Levels

| Level | Name | Reached when |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | implemented | the parliament has a directory under `optv/parliaments/` |
| 2 | samples pass | its sample sessions satisfy every criterion gating level 2 |
| 3 | QC cleared | Whisper transcripts of the sample sessions confirm the text, and licence and platform fit are attested; the parliament is ready for a backfill and for going live |
| 4 | backfilled | the manifest declares the periods to be published as processed in full |
| 5 | live | the manifest declares a platform instance that serves the data |

Levels 2 and 3 are computed from the sample sessions named in the manifest. Levels 4 and 5 are declared there. A parliament at a declared level keeps it when a criterion below fails; the failure shows as a regression. Levels 1 to 4 are published as `in development`, level 5 as `production`.

## Criteria

| Criterion | Gates level | Kind | Rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| `impl.files` | 2 | computed | The parliament directory has manifest.yaml, workflow.py, common.py, README.md, scraper/, parsers/ and merger/. |
| `impl.manifest` | 2 | computed | The manifest resolves a locale, a language code, periods and known stages, and its readiness block is well-formed. |
| `impl.contract` | 2 | computed | common.py imports and exports a Config built on BaseConfig, and SessionStatus. |
| `impl.tests` | 2 | computed | The parliament has a test module of its own under tests/. |
| `samples.declared` | 2 | computed | At least three sample sessions are declared, and each one is published. |
| `samples.stages` | 2 | computed | Every sample session went through all the stages the manifest supports. |
| `samples.valid` | 2 | computed | The Stage 2 validator (full schema, semantic rules) finds no error and no sentence timed outside its media. |
| `samples.import_fields` | 2 | computed | Every speech has the fields without which the platform importer rejects it. |
| `samples.import_gate` | 2 | computed | No speech the merger marked as low confidence would be imported with its text. |
| `samples.speaker_wid` | 2 | computed | The share of speeches whose first person has a Wikidata ID reaches the threshold. |
| `samples.timing` | 2 | computed | The share of sentences with a start and end time reaches the threshold. |
| `samples.text_plausible` | 2 | computed | No debate speech the merger passed carries more text than its clip could hold. |
| `samples.rights` | 2 | computed | Every media and text entry names its creator and licence. |
| `qc.whisper_coverage` | 3 | computed | The share of text-bearing sample speeches with a Whisper transcript reaches the threshold. |
| `qc.fidelity` | 3 | computed | The median similarity between the published text and the transcript reaches the threshold, overall and in every session. |
| `qc.mismatch` | 3 | computed | The share of speeches whose text does not match their audio stays under the threshold. |
| `qc.reviewed` | 3 | attested | A person reviewed the Whisper reports of the current evidence. |
| `release.licence` | 3 | attested | The rights to republish video and text are cleared. |
| `release.platform` | 3 | attested | The platform can import and present the data. |
| `release.backfilled` | 4 | attested | The periods to be published are processed in full. |
| `release.live` | 5 | attested | A platform instance serves the data. |

A result is `pass`, `fail`, `not_evaluated` (the evidence does not exist yet), `not_applicable` or `stale` (the evidence describes an earlier state of the data). Thresholds are the defaults in `optv/scripts/readiness/config.py` unless a manifest overrides one with a reason.
